cell_type.evidence: Bacterial cells were incubated with GNSs (50 and 100 μg mL−1), GNSs-HA (50 and 100 μg mL−1), GNSs+HA (GNSs: 98.6 μg mL−1, HA: 1.4 μg mL−1), and HA (1.4 μg mL−1) for 60 min, and the mixtures were centrifuged at 88 g for 5 min to remove the agglomerated materials.
